description: This file contains utility functions for SDL surface manipulation, including surface scaling, color adjustments, masking, and rectangle drawing, as well as functions for handling SDL key symbols and surface portions. It is part of the Wesnoth game project.

classes.name: not_alpha
classes.description: Functor to check if a pixel's alpha value is not zero.

classes.name: surface_restorer
classes.description: Class to temporarily restore a portion of a surface.

methods.name: sdl_keysym_from_name
methods.description: Converts a key name string to an SDLKey symbol.

methods.name: point_in_rect
methods.description: Checks if a point (x,y) lies within a given SDL_Rect.

methods.name: rects_overlap
methods.description: Checks if two SDL_Rect rectangles overlap.

methods.name: intersect_rects
methods.description: Returns the intersection of two SDL_Rect rectangles.

methods.name: make_neutral_surface
methods.description: Creates a neutral (standardized) surface from an existing surface.

methods.name: create_optimized_surface
methods.description: Converts a surface to an optimized format for display.

methods.name: scale_surface
methods.description: Scales a surface to a new width and height.

methods.name: scale_surface_blended
methods.description: Scales a surface with blending, using bilinear interpolation.

methods.name: adjust_surface_colour
methods.description: Adjusts the RGB color components of a surface.

methods.name: greyscale_image
methods.description: Converts a surface to greyscale.

methods.name: brighten_image
methods.description: Brightens a surface by a fixed amount.

methods.name: adjust_surface_alpha
methods.description: Adjusts the alpha transparency of a surface.

methods.name: adjust_surface_alpha_add
methods.description: Adds a fixed value to the alpha channel of a surface.

methods.name: mask_surface
methods.description: Applies a mask surface to another surface, modifying alpha transparency.

methods.name: blur_surface
methods.description: Applies a blurring effect to a surface.

methods.name: cut_surface
methods.description: Cuts a rectangular portion from a surface.

methods.name: blend_surface
methods.description: Blends a color onto a surface with a given opacity.

methods.name: flip_surface
methods.description: Flips a surface horizontally.

methods.name: flop_surface
methods.description: Flips a surface vertically.

methods.name: create_compatible_surface
methods.description: Creates a new surface compatible with an existing one.

methods.name: fill_rect_alpha
methods.description: Fills a rectangle area on a surface with a color and alpha transparency.

methods.name: get_surface_portion
methods.description: Extracts a portion of a surface defined by an SDL_Rect.

methods.name: get_non_transperant_portion
methods.description: Calculates the non-transparent bounding rectangle of a surface.

methods.name: operator== (SDL_Rect)
methods.description: Equality comparison for SDL_Rect.

methods.name: operator!= (SDL_Rect)
methods.description: Inequality comparison for SDL_Rect.

methods.name: operator== (SDL_Color)
methods.description: Equality comparison for SDL_Color.

methods.name: operator!= (SDL_Color)
methods.description: Inequality comparison for SDL_Color.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Returns the inverse (complement) of an SDL_Color.

methods.name: pixel_data::read
methods.description: Reads RGB values from a configuration object into pixel_data.

methods.name: surface_restorer::restore
methods.description: Restores a surface portion to its previous state.

methods.name: surface_restorer::update
methods.description: Updates the stored surface portion.

methods.name: surface_restorer::cancel
methods.description: Cancels the restoration, discarding stored surface.

methods.name: draw_rectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle border on a surface.

methods.name: draw_solid_tinted_rectangle
methods.description: Draws a filled rectangle with color and transparency.
